messages: Agent 1: Identified 18 material(s) from project documents.
Agent 2: No sources found for: Core material (Quarry run), Soil (dredged) for Phase 1 capital dredging, Geotextile membrane
Agent 3: Computed 107 cost estimate(s), 107 environmental assessment(s), 107 resilience assessment(s).
Agent 4: Evaluated 14 alternative(s) using AHP-TOPSIS with 4 criteria.
Agent 4: Primary recommendation is Gargaon Quarry (Hillock B) (closeness=0.9166).
Agent 4: Identified 10 viable fallback(s) out of 13 alternative(s).
project_scope: Development of a deep-draft, all-weather container port at Vadhavan, including a 1,000 m contiguous berth per terminal (initial Phase 1), breakwater construction (≈10,140 m length requiring ~32.1 million t rock), quarry sourcing and road connectivity, container terminal facilities with dock cranes (30-32.5 moves/hr), operational schedule of 350 days/year, 21 hours/day, and provision for future expansion to nine 1,000 m terminals by 2040 supporting up to 24,000 TEU berth capacity.
project_constraints: Proximity to existing fishing harbour and fishermen settlements in the north
Shankodhar point in the middle of the sea must be preserved
Mangroves and rocky outcrop near the coast
Minimum 300 m clearance between shoreline and bund to avoid disturbing mangrove flow
Locating terminal and onshore facilities on reclaimed land
Minimize impact on adjoining population and villages
Rail and road access planned for minimal impact on adjoining village
Facilities for Coast Guard to improve security
Environmental considerations for green design concepts
Physical site constraints identified by RHDHV team
project_timeline: Phase 1 development (initial 1,000 m berth and breakwater) targeted for completion by 2030; Phase 2 and further expansion to nine 1,000 m terminals planned up to 2040.
